page.overview:
Who is Chinchizard?

He also makes a brief appearence in "Hoots."

He appears to be a green, humanoid chinchilla person with a goatee. As his occupation suggests, he is wearing a red Wizard robe and a yellow Wizard cap. He also appears to have a mustache.

Chinchizard appears to revolve around a social hierarchy. He is seen being very friendly to Berdzerd but also very mean to Abracadaniel, since he is frowned upon in the Wizard community.
